caption: The drawing shows two views (front and side) of a rectangular shelf clock with detailed proportions and dimensions annotated throughout. The front view displays the clock's structure, which includes a decorative top with a central finial and curved side embellishments, a clock face encased in a square housing with Roman numerals, and a keyhole on the left of the clock face. The housing sits on a rectangular base with a broader width than the upper portion and has a curved cutout at the bottom center. The side view presents the depth and vertical structure, showing that the top decorative portion is thinner than the base, with proportions and step details indicated. The clock face is circular, and both views contain handwritten measurements; for example, the overall height is 34 inches, and the base width is 12.5 inches, with other labeled segments. The clock consists of mahogany inlay as noted in the lower right, with the manufacturer identified as Ginsberg & Levy, Inc., 815 Madison Ave. The scale is given as 2 inches equals 1 foot. The drawing is done on a beige background in fine black ink, and the composition is technical with clean, straight lines, clear labels, and no added subjective or decorative texture.
title: Shelf Clock
